instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Add evidence to a decision I am making, at any time, so that its answers can cite it, or bring it in from another of my decisions", and give it decision_id (The decision); evidence (The rows to add: each { ref, claim } or { ref, from: { decision_id, ref } }).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:add-decision-evidence and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Adds evidence rows to a decision in the person's own records: each { ref, claim }, or { ref, from: { decision_id, ref } } to bring in another of the person's decisions' evidence as it stood.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-revision (records:read, records:write); decision-step (records:read, records:write); decision-call (records:write); decision-evidence (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-answered-step (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-option (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-candidate (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-report (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-carried-out (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-history (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-method (records:read, records:write); decision-part (records:read, records:write); decision-refs (records:read, records:write).
